name: quentino-app
description: Pošta, zákaznický chat a publikování na sociální sítě pro Quentino
author: Quentino

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --outDir dist/ptdist && tsc -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/preflight.mjs channels && node tools/migrate-test.cjs && node tools/ptrans/detect-test.cjs && node tools/ptrans/seourl-test.cjs && node tools/ptrans/nosource-test.cjs && node tools/ptrans/tidy-test.cjs && node tools/ptrans/source-test.cjs && node tools/ptrans/facts-test.cjs && node tools/catalog-test.cjs && node tools/upstock-test.cjs && node tools/zpl-test.cjs && node tools/sheet-test.cjs && node tools/orderfeed-test.cjs && node tools/packing-test.cjs && node tools/notify-test.cjs && node tools/maillist-test.cjs && node tools/swift-lint.cjs
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.dist: node scripts/preflight.mjs env --target=auto && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/preflight.mjs dist && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/preflight.mjs env --target=mac && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/preflight.mjs dist && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/preflight.mjs env --target=win && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/preflight.mjs dist && electron-builder --win
